description: Customs declaration extraction — import/export/transit declarations, Turkish beyanname, UK C88/SAD, EU SAD

Name.description: Full legal name of the consignor/exporter/sender company

TaxId.description: Tax identification number or EORI number of the consignor. May be labeled 'VKN', 'Tax No', 'EORI', 'TIN'

Country.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the consignor. Return ONLY the code, e.g. 'GB', 'DE', 'TR'

Name.description: Full legal name of the consignee/importer/receiver company

TaxId.description: Tax identification number or EORI number of the consignee. May be labeled 'VKN', 'Tax No', 'EORI', 'TIN'

Country.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the consignee. Return ONLY the code, e.g. 'GB', 'DE', 'TR'

DeclarationNumber.description: Unique declaration number or reference number. May be labeled 'Beyanname No', 'Declaration No', 'Entry Number', 'MRN'

DeclarationDate.description: Date of the customs declaration. May be labeled 'Tescil Tarihi', 'Declaration Date', 'Entry Date'

DeclarationType.description: Type/regime of declaration: IM (import), EX (export), TR (transit), CO (community). Return the 2-letter code

Export.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the country of export/dispatch. Return ONLY the code

Import.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the country of destination/import. Return ONLY the code

Origin.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the country of origin. Return ONLY the code

Packages.description: Total number of packages in the declaration

Mode.description: Mode of transport at the border. Numeric code: 1=sea, 2=rail, 3=road, 4=air, 6=RoRo. Return ONLY the number

VehicleCode.description: Vehicle identification at the border: ship IMO, truck plate number, flight number

VehicleCountry.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the vehicle nationality. Return ONLY the code

FreightCurrency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for freight amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

InsuranceCurrency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for insurance amount

Incoterm.description: Incoterms delivery term code: EXW, FCA, FOB, CFR, CIF, CIP, CPT, DAP, DPU, DDP. Return ONLY the 3-letter code

IncotermLocation.description: Location associated with the incoterm (e.g. port name, city)

ExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate applied to the invoice currency

CommercialRef.description: Commercial reference number or trader reference

OfficeCode.description: Customs office code (e.g. 'GB000040', 'TR340100'). Numeric or alphanumeric identifier

DeclarantTaxId.description: EORI or tax ID of the customs declarant/agent

InvoiceAmount.description: Total invoice/statistical value of all goods

InvoiceCurrency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code of the invoice (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, TRY)

GoodsItems.description: List of goods/commodity items in the declaration. Each item is a separate line in the declaration

GtipCode.description: HS code or GTIP code (commodity code). Usually 6-12 digits, may contain dots

CpcCode.description: Customs Procedure Code (CPC). Usually 4-7 digit code (e.g. 1000, 4000, 4051)

SupplementaryUnit.description: Supplementary units/quantity in a secondary unit of measure

GrossWeight.description: Gross weight of this item in kilograms (KG)

NetWeight.description: Net weight of this item in kilograms (KG)

OriginCountry.description: 2-letter ISO country code of origin for this item. Return ONLY the code
